tasks.subject: Add failing test for DC API entry-set selection parser
tasks.description: Write a JVM unit test for a pure parser that maps androidx SelectedCredentialSet data (credentialId + matcher metadata JSON containing dcql_cred_id) into a wallet-side selection model. Must be pure Kotlin (no android.util.*) so it runs on the JVM. Test must fail before the parser exists.

tasks.subject: Implement DcApiSelection pure parser
tasks.description: Create dcapi/DcApiSelection.kt: pure-Kotlin model + parser turning the matcher's per-credential metadata JSON (dcql_cred_id, dcql_credential_set_index, dcql_option_index) plus credentialId into a list of selected (credentialId, dcqlQueryId) pairs. No Android types.

tasks.subject: Read selectedCredentialSet in DcPresentationActivity
tasks.description: Read getRequest.selectedCredentialSet (androidx.credentials.registry.provider) and fall back to selectedEntryId. Convert via DcApiSelection into the route's selection list. Log the resolved selection so the fix is verifiable in logcat.

tasks.subject: Make resolveDcApi credential filter set-aware
tasks.description: Replace the single-id filter in PresentationClient.resolveDcApi with a set-aware filter over all selected credential ids, so multi-credential credential_sets requests survive instead of tripping the §6.4.2 fail-closed guard. Route.Present carries a list instead of a single id; update WalletApp and PresentScanScreen call sites.

tasks.subject: Verify on device: no second consent in DC API flow
tasks.description: Build, install on Pixel 51221FDAS00096, capture logcat, have the user reproduce. Confirm selected set is non-null, candidates=1, canAutoAuthorize true, no consent card. Also confirm full unit-test suite is at the known-good baseline (56 tests, 2 permanent TransactionDataTest failures).
